items.title: Scaler EQ Pro Announced With Note-Aware EQ And MIDI-Controlled Live Mode
items.excerpt: Scaler EQ Pro detects a track's key automatically and boosts frequencies inside that key while cutting the ones outside it. Adds MIDI-controlled Live Mode, dynamic EQ with sidechain, mid/side, zero latency. $99, ships 23 September 2026.

items.title: Initial D artist MOTSU releases FREE zero-latency vocal tuner MotTune MIDI
items.excerpt: MOTSU of m.o.v.e and DeeJei.Tokyo released MotTune MIDI, a free real-time pitch correction and vocoder plugin with a zero-latency live mode you drive from MIDI. The companion iPhone app separates vocals from songs on-device.

items.title: Is AI Slop Giving Artists and Creators a New Life?
items.excerpt: Fiverr data shows demand for human music trades climbing as AI output floods the market: topline writing up 466%, songwriting up 426%, strings up 116%. Olivia Rodrigo's handmade lyric-video commission became news on its own.

items.title: Sonos CEO explains how 'Custom Agents' will work for listeners
items.excerpt: Sonos CEO Tom Conrad described Custom Agents: listeners pick an inference engine (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Grok), give it a voice, a name and a personality, then run several at once for recommendations or live-music discovery.

items.title: klattsch Turns 1980s Speech Synthesis Into A Singing Instrument
items.excerpt: Crash United's klattsch rebuilds Dennis Klatt's 1980 formant synthesizer as a playable singing instrument, with a piano roll, phoneme assignment and hand-drawn pitch curves. Free in the browser, $9.99 on desktop and Android.

items.title: Mark My Words: AI Music Is the End of the Artist Economy
items.excerpt: Opinion piece arguing generative music tools break the economics independent artists depend on.

items.title: Pros Discuss AI In Music Production - Tool, Threat Or The Future?
items.excerpt: Working engineers and producers debate where AI already sits in their sessions and where they refuse to let it in.

items.title: Latest Suno lawsuit accuses AI company of violating the publicity rights of musicians
items.excerpt: David Lowery, Jason Isbell and others sue Suno claiming it encoded musicians' identities into its model, a publicity-rights claim rather than a copyright one.

items.title: Experimental Tool Promises To Give The Roland Aira Eurorack Effects Modules New Superpowers
items.excerpt: A community tool unlocks custom processing on Roland's Aira Eurorack effect modules.
